name: Sbu Clean

replaces.name: Cleanup: Phone Storage Cleaner
replaces.price_model: Free download, weekly or lifetime subscription, 7-day trial; free tier capped at about 5-25 deletions a day

replaces.name: Swipewipe: Photo Cleaner
replaces.price_model: Free with ads (video ads gate deletion) or weekly/yearly subscription, 3-day trial; free swipes limited then 7-8 hour wait

one_thing: Frees space in the Photos library one decision at a time and closes with the space freed.

features.name: Swipe to keep or delete
features.description: Card deck over a month, recent items or a random set; swipe or tap Keep / Delete / Back, with VoiceOver actions.
features.reason: Paywalled core of both originals (deletion is what the free tier caps).

features.name: Month-by-month timeline
features.description: List of months with progress per month, resumable.
features.reason: Swipewipe's main navigation, behind the limit.

features.name: Bin with review and confirm
features.description: Everything marked goes to a bin; review grid, then one system delete via PHAssetChangeRequest with danger confirm.
features.reason: Both originals end with a review screen; deletion is the paywalled step.

features.name: Duplicates and similar photos
features.description: Vision feature-print grouping with a tight threshold, best shot suggested (sharpness, face quality, favourite, edits), never auto-selected.

features.name: Screenshots and screen recordings
features.description: Smart album of screenshots, bulk select.

features.name: Large videos by size
features.description: Videos sorted by file size with inline playback.

features.name: Video compression
features.description: AVAssetExportSession to a smaller preset, original deleted only after confirm.

features.name: Freeable and freed space figure
features.description: One figure: space you can free, then space freed, closed by the full stop.
features.reason: Both show it; Sbu keeps it to one figure.

features.name: No limits, no trial, no ads
features.description: Unlimited deletions from the first launch; no paywall, no card, no ad gate.
features.reason: Paywall/price (88), ads (36), trial charges (31) and daily limits (20) are the top pains.

features.name: Progress that survives
features.description: Decisions and per-month progress stored by PHAsset localIdentifier, migrated across versions; seen photos never reappear.
features.reason: Lost progress and reappearing photos after updates or freezes (7).

features.name: Fast, crash-free on large libraries
features.description: Incremental indexing in background tasks, paging fetches, no full-library load at launch; works on iOS 27.
features.reason: Crashes, freezes on delete, won't open on iOS 27 (29).

features.name: Honest space note
features.description: After deleting, say photos stay 30 days in Recently Deleted and space returns when it is emptied; freed space computed from PHAssetResource sizes, not estimates.

features.name: Photos only, nothing else touched
features.description: No contacts, mail or Hidden album handling; Hidden excluded unless the user opts in.
features.reason: Wrong deletions of contacts, emails, Hidden items (3).

features.name: Video plays in the card
features.description: Every video plays with sound before deciding.

features.name: Strict duplicates
features.description: Exact duplicates separated from 'similar'; bursts shown as similar, never as duplicates.

features.name: Plain first screen
features.description: Access screen then home list, no onboarding quiz.

features.name: Keep forever list
features.description: Items marked keep never come back in the deck.

features.name: Live Photo to still
features.description: Convert Live Photos to stills with confirm (loses the video part).

features.name: Albums one at a time
features.description: Swipe through a single album.

features.name: Free space widget
features.description: WidgetKit small widget with free space.
features.reason: Cleanup widget, already built in Apps/SbuClean.

screens.name: Access
screens.purpose: Explain and request Photos access; works with limited access.

screens.name: Home
elements: List .insetGrouped: Months, Recent, Random, Duplicates, Similar, Screenshots, Videos, Live Photos, Compress

screens.name: Months
elements: List of months with item count and progress

screens.name: Swipe
screens.purpose: Decide one item at a time.
elements: card with photo or playing video

screens.name: Videos and Compress
screens.purpose: Large videos by size; compress selected.

data_model.storage: Local JSON/Codable files in Application Support (decisions, progress, analysis cache); no photos copied. Library is PhotoKit. No iCloud sync needed.

monetization.price: Cleanup: weekly 6.99-13 EUR / 9.99-12 USD in reviews, yearly and lifetime tiers, 7-day trial with card; Swipewipe: 8 EUR / 9.99 USD weekly, 79.99 EUR yearly, 3-day trial
paywalled_features: Deleting beyond ~5-25 items a day (Cleanup) or a few swipes then 7-8 h wait (Swipewipe)
All cleaning categories (duplicates, similar, screenshots, videos)
Ad-free deletion (Swipewipe gates deletion behind video ads)
Going back to missed days, trim/crop (Swipewipe)
monetization.notes: Deletion itself is the paywall: the user does the sorting work, then pays to commit it.

system_frameworks.name: PhotoKit
system_frameworks.use: Fetch, resources sizes, deletion, change observer, limited library picker

system_frameworks.name: Vision
system_frameworks.use: VNGenerateImageFeaturePrintRequest for similar/duplicates, VNDetectFaceCaptureQualityRequest for best shot

system_frameworks.name: AVFoundation / AVKit
system_frameworks.use: Video playback in cards, AVAssetExportSession compression

system_frameworks.name: BackgroundTasks
system_frameworks.use: BGProcessingTask for library analysis on large libraries

review_risks.risk: Sbu Clean 1.0 was already rejected in the 14/10 lot; photo cleaners are among the most crowded niches with dozens of clones.
review_risks.mitigation: Answer the 9 Resolution Center questions before any resubmit; submit alone, one per week; review notes list what differs (no deletion cap, on-device Vision duplicates, compression, honest Recently Deleted note); first line of the description about the function, not the promise block.

review_risks.risk: Swipe-left/right deck and month list mirror Swipewipe.
review_risks.mitigation: Native List/insetGrouped and SbuKit cards, own wording, no Swipewipe colours, mascots or copy; buttons equivalent to swipes.

review_risks.risk: App must work with limited or denied Photos access.
review_risks.mitigation: Limited access works on the selected set with a 'manage selection' row; denied shows Open Settings; purpose string IT/EN tied to the delete action.

review_risks.risk: Bin/Recently Deleted could look like Photos.
review_risks.mitigation: SbuKit design, no Photos icons or layout; deletion uses the system confirmation dialog.

review_risks.risk: Only public PhotoKit APIs; must not hang on iOS 27 large libraries.
review_risks.mitigation: Paged fetches, background analysis, test on iOS 27 with 50k-item library.

review_risks.risk: Sbu Collage (wave 3) also reads Photos; Sbu Docs scans images.
review_risks.mitigation: Clean only deletes/compresses; Collage only composes; noted in review notes.
